description.summary: Advanced pipeline with LLM-enriched documents, testing whether enrichment helps OpenAI's text-embedding-3-large (the larger, higher-dimensional embedder).
description.how_it_works: Same as run-3 but with a bigger embedder: each document is first enriched by an LLM with a title and summary, then split into character chunks and embedded with text-embedding-3-large. At query time the Advanced pipeline rewrites the question, retrieves chunks for both the original and rewritten query, and reranks them with the BGE reranker before the chat model answers.
